name: macws-aquarium-runner
description: Provides MacWS web-link routing and the repeatable WebGL Aquarium workload in VS Code's built-in Simple Browser.

macwsAquarium.url.description: WebGL workload URL opened in VS Code's built-in Simple Browser.

macwsAquarium.openOnStartup.description: Open the 60,000-fish workload automatically after the VS Code workbench becomes ready. Keep this disabled for ordinary browsing and video playback so the benchmark does not compete for GPU memory.
